samples.input: A software project checkpoint says 'API v1 frozen'. A new request asks to add a field. Produce a continuity-safe response.
samples.target: Do not silently alter v1. Add the field in a versioned v2 or backward-compatible extension only if the contract permits it; record the change and compatibility impact.

samples.input: You must choose one of three experiments: duplicate a known result, test a suspected failure mode, or add a new feature. Which has highest value when promotion is blocked by an unexplained regression?
samples.target: Test the suspected failure mode. Resolving the blocker has higher decision value than duplicating a known pass or adding capability before safety is understood.
